$description: Adjoin theme: dark. Defines color tokens only.

page.$description: App canvas behind all content. Not for cards; use surface.default.

raised.$description: Popovers, menus and dropdowns that float above cards.

sunken.$description: Wells, table headers and inactive chips set into a card.

hover.$description: Background of a hovered row or list item.

$root.$description: Resting fill for the single main action in a view.

hover.$description: Hovered fill for the single main action in a view.

pressed.$description: Pressed fill for the single main action in a view.

$root.$description: Resting fill for supporting actions next to a primary action.

hover.$description: Hovered fill for supporting actions next to a primary action.

pressed.$description: Pressed fill for supporting actions next to a primary action.

$root.$description: Resting fill for destructive actions such as delete or revoke.

hover.$description: Hovered fill for destructive actions such as delete or revoke.

pressed.$description: Pressed fill for destructive actions such as delete or revoke.

$root.$description: Fill of a danger banner or toast: something failed or was blocked. System status only, never data.
Fill of a warning banner or toast: something needs attention soon. System status only, never data.
Fill of a success banner or toast: an operation completed. System status only, never data.
Fill of an info banner: neutral system information.
Fill of an insight callout: a finding worth attention. Not for system status.

selection.$description: Selected rows, active filter chips and chart brush ranges.

subtle.$description: Labels, captions and axis text. Not for body copy.

primary.$description: Label text on the primary action fill.

secondary.$description: Label text on the secondary action fill.

danger.$description: Label text on the danger action fill.

$root.$description: Text inside a danger banner. Neutral on purpose; the icon and border carry the flag.

on-emphasis.$description: Text on the solid danger badge fill.

$root.$description: Text inside a warning banner. Neutral on purpose; the icon and border carry the flag.

on-emphasis.$description: Text on the solid warning badge fill.

$root.$description: Text inside a success banner. Neutral on purpose; the icon and border carry the flag.

on-emphasis.$description: Text on the solid success badge fill.
Text on the solid info badge fill.

$root.$description: Text on the insight callout fill.

on-emphasis.$description: Text on the solid insight badge.

increase.$description: Value went up. Direction is carried by the arrow and sign, never by color.

decrease.$description: Value went down. Direction is carried by the arrow and sign, never by color.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus outline on every interactive element.

increase.$description: Arrow for a value that rose.

decrease.$description: Arrow for a value that fell.

1.$description: Series 1 in charts with categorical data. Meaning is only 'different from the other series'.

2.$description: Series 2 in charts with categorical data. Meaning is only 'different from the other series'.

3.$description: Series 3 in charts with categorical data. Meaning is only 'different from the other series'.

4.$description: Series 4 in charts with categorical data. Meaning is only 'different from the other series'.

5.$description: Series 5 in charts with categorical data. Meaning is only 'different from the other series'.

6.$description: Series 6 in charts with categorical data. Meaning is only 'different from the other series'.

muted.$description: Every series except the highlighted one, during hover or focus.

1.$description: Sequential scale step 1 of 5; 1 is the lowest value and sits closest to the surface.

2.$description: Sequential scale step 2 of 5; 1 is the lowest value and sits closest to the surface.

3.$description: Sequential scale step 3 of 5; 1 is the lowest value and sits closest to the surface.

4.$description: Sequential scale step 4 of 5; 1 is the lowest value and sits closest to the surface.

5.$description: Sequential scale step 5 of 5; 1 is the lowest value and sits closest to the surface.

below-3.$description: Diverging scale: distance from a midpoint (magnitude), not good or bad.

below-2.$description: Diverging scale: distance from a midpoint (magnitude), not good or bad.

below-1.$description: Diverging scale: distance from a midpoint (magnitude), not good or bad.

midpoint.$description: Diverging scale: distance from a midpoint (magnitude), not good or bad.

above-1.$description: Diverging scale: distance from a midpoint (magnitude), not good or bad.

above-2.$description: Diverging scale: distance from a midpoint (magnitude), not good or bad.

above-3.$description: Diverging scale: distance from a midpoint (magnitude), not good or bad.

insight.$description: The mark an insight is about: an anomaly point or highlighted series.

met.$description: Value meets its goal or SLA.

at-risk.$description: Value is within warning range of its goal. Always pair with an icon or outline.

missed.$description: Value breaches its goal: an alert. Always pair with an icon or outline.

average.$description: Average or baseline line on a chart.

annotation.$description: Event markers and callouts on a chart.

missing.$description: Null heatmap cells and gaps in a series.
